'''Druckenwellians''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the planet [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], an industrial world in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]]. [[Jai Maruk]] was a Druckenwellian.<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous" />
